_note: Generic 2-axis CNC lathe and power chucks. All values are ASSUMED catalogue orders of magnitude for this size class, not a specific maker's data; they are inputs of the sensitivity study. Jaw masses and centroid radii decide the centrifugal loss of clamping force (VDI 3106 method).

lathe.clamp_mcodes_note: two preset chuck pressures selected by M-code: builder-specific example codes, not a standard

clamping.source: VDI 3106 (2004) clamping-force method: F_sp0 = S_sp (F_spz + F_c), F_spz = S_z x (cutting force transferred) / mu; S_z, S_sp >= 1.5 and mu = 0.1 for smooth jaws on machined steel are quoted from memory, not re-checked against the guideline

notes.half_angle_deg: half the contact arc of one jaw: 4 deg for a standard soft jaw bored to the grip diameter (narrow contact), 50 deg for pie jaws (3 x 100 deg)
notes.setup_min: jaw change + boring soft jaws to the grip diameter (pie jaws must be bored for every diameter): assumed shop times
notes.invest_rel: relative purchase cost of the chuck / jaw set: judgement
